items.title_en: US Firm Allegedly Fires Entire Indian Team Over 5-Minute Call: ‘80 Employees, All Gone’
items.title_zh: 据称美国公司在 5 分钟通话中解雇了整个印度团队：“80 名员工全部消失”
items.summary_en: The US bank allegedly asked employees to work from home over operational issues, and later in the evening, asked the employees to join a call where they were laid off
items.summary_zh: 据称，这家美国银行因运营问题而要求员工在家工作，并在当晚晚些时候要求员工参加被解雇的电话会议
